ai.title: Post-Training Large Language Models with LLMON
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.38120v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) treat all context tokens uniformly, lacking explicit separation between executable instructions and passive data. This leads to prompt injection vulnerabilities, ambiguous instruction binding, and unreliable execution control. We present a post-training methodology using LLMON (LLM Object Notation), a framework that enables separating instructions from data and requires explicit identifier-based execution. We construct a large-scale structured training corpus of 4.6B tokens spanning general, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and tool-calling data, augmented with distractor-infused variants in which competing instructions and irrelevant data segments are present in context but not referenced. Post-training two Granite-4.1 base models (3B and 8B) through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, we show that LLMON-structured supervision reduces attack success rates on indirect prompt-injection benchmarks from 53-100% to 0.02-5.6% while preserving general capabilities. We further introduce attention-based interpretability metrics that diagnose failure modes at individual transformer layers for structured inputs, revealing how our approach reshapes internal attention patterns. Our results demonstrate that explicit execution semantics can be taught through standard post-training without architectural modification.
ai.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) treat all context tokens uniformly, lacking explicit separation between executable instructions and passive data.

ai.title: Rubricon: Automated Rubric Generation and Refinement for LLM Evaluation and Training
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.38220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rubrics enable reward assignment on tasks without verifiable answers, but are expensive to manually produce from scratch. We present Rubricon, a pipeline that generates discriminative rubrics without requiring human preference labels, rubric annotation, or generator-model training. Using any LLM, Rubricon samples multiple rubrics, selects the most discriminative candidate, adds criteria to capture overlooked requirements or response flaws, and prunes criteria that are misaligned or shallow. Alongside LLM self-critique and test-time scaling, Rubricon uses observed criterion pass rates on example model responses to guide refinement. Across five professional, consumer, clinical, and general-use LLM benchmarks, Rubricon produces rubrics whose scores of frontier LLM responses exhibit 9% greater alignment with labor-intensive expert-authored rubrics, compared to the best alternative synthetic rubric generation method among RRD, QSRG, OpenRubrics, and agentic generation via harnesses like Codex. On HealthBench, post-training a Qwen3.5-9B model with Rubricon rubrics yields 4.5% better performance than training with rubrics from the strongest alternative synthetic rubric generator, RRD.
ai.summary: Rubrics enable reward assignment on tasks without verifiable answers, but are expensive to manually produce from scratch.

ai.title: Can LLMs Faithfully Solve Ontology Engineering Tasks? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.38326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ontological knowledge underpins large language model (LLM) performance on knowledge-intensive tasks. However, existing evaluations of LLMs' ontological understanding largely rely on behavioral correctness, leaving the underlying mechanisms unexplained. Existing mechanistic interpretability work has largely focused on instance-level factual knowledge, leaving ontological knowledge under-explored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MIOE, a causal-abstraction benchmark that evaluates interchange interventions for two ontology engineering tasks: entity typing and subsumption prediction. MIOE tests whether learned internal intervention targets can change an ontology-level target answer while preserving class-specific auxiliary information. Across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B, we evaluate SAE-, DBM-, and DAS-based methods, including multi-task and multi-layer variants. Distributed subspace methods give the strongest results and generalize across prompt settings, but the induced changes remain only partially separated from auxiliary class-specific information. Multi-task objectives and contiguous layer-window interventions improve this balance, while class-level analyses reveal substantial variation across ontology classes. These results suggest that ontological predictions are mechanistically accessible in LLMs, although current methods do not yet isolate a cleanly disentangled causal mechanism for ontological knowledge.
ai.summary: Ontological knowledge underpins large language model (LLM) performance on knowledge-intensive tasks.

ai.raw_summary: Commission accepts Temu's action plan to remedy the breach of the Digital Services Act Anonymous (not verified) Mon, 10/26/2026 - 10:28 The European Commission has accepted Temu's action plan to comply with the Digital Services Act (DSA) and tackle the availability of illegal products online. Temu's plan focuses on five measures to remedy its breach of the DSA. The company will carry out a platform-specific risk analysis. It will also use reliable metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of the mitigation measures put in place in reducing the risk of dissemination of illegal content. The platform will assess the limitations of its content moderation and analyse whether, and how, its recommender systems may amplify the spread of illegal goods. Additionally, Temu will examine the influence of intentional manipulation and amplification of illegal items, including by sellers exploiting Temu's features to spread potentially illegal listings. The company now has four months to conduct an interim risk assessment that covers a six-month period, until 30 November 2026, to ensure the implementation of the measures of the action plan. The action plan is another example of how the DSA is enhancing consumer protection online and limiting the spread of illegal products in Europe. The action plan was submitted following a non-compliance decision in May 2026 , in which the Commission found that Temu had failed to comply with its risk assessment obligations, and issued a €200 million fine. trade.source_name: 財政部關務署 新聞

trade.raw_summary: 財政部關務署近日接獲民眾反映，疑有不肖人士透過通訊軟體LINE，以網路交友、寄送包裹等話術取得民眾信任，並冒用海關人員名義，要求民眾匯款至指定帳戶。關務署鄭重澄清，海關關員絕不會透過私人通訊軟體要求民眾匯款或私下處理包裹或進出口貨物，呼籲民眾提高警覺，以免受騙。 關務署強調，海關辦理進出口貨物通關及稅費徵收，均依相關法令及正式行政程序辦理，不會由首長或關員透過私人通訊軟體，要求民眾匯款至指定私人帳戶，也不會以個人身分承諾協助寄送、保管、放行包裹或進出口貨物。相關稅費及罰鍰均應透過合法繳納管道入帳國庫，民眾切勿依不明人士指示匯款。 關務署再次提醒，民眾如遇網路交友對象以寄送包裹、禮物或貴重物品為由，要求支付通關費、保險費或其他費用，應審慎查證，切勿輕信對方提供的海關人員姓名、職稱或通訊軟體帳號。如有疑義，可至關務署官方網站（https://web.customs.gov.tw）查詢，或撥打關務署電話（02）2550-5500及165反詐騙諮詢專線確認，共同防範詐騙，保障自身財產安全。 新聞稿聯絡人：劉科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2102

trade.title: 海關籲請正確申報統計用數量，提升貿易統計品質
trade.raw_summary: 財政部關務署表示，高品質的海關進出口貿易統計資料，除金額之正確性外，統一的計量單位亦不容忽視。依聯合國國際商品貿易統計手冊建議，同一稅則六碼下貨品應盡量使用相同之數量單位，據此，關務署依各貨品不同屬性，訂定一致性之統計用數量單位，共17種供報關使用，俾利國際規範接軌及提高資料準確度。 關務署指出，進口報單中數量欄位有二種：一為第41欄「數量（單位）」，係計價用數量，請依發票所載交易數量填列；二為第42欄「數量（統計用）」，請依「中華民國海關進口稅則輸出入貨品分類表合訂本」單位欄內所載單位換算後填列，以取得具比較性的數量資料。 關務署舉例說明，部分紡織品之統計用單位為MTK（平方公尺），惟常見之計價單位為碼或英吋，申報時若未將長、寬個別換算為公尺即直接相乘，就會產生誤報情形。以下為常見換算範例，提醒業者注意： 一、碼數換算（1碼=0.9144公尺）：「長1,214碼、寬1.5公尺」之尼龍胚布，應先將長度（碼）轉換為公尺再乘寬，正確計算為 (1,214 × 0.9144) × 1.5 ≒ 1,665.12平方公尺。 二、英吋換算（1英吋=0.0254公尺）：「長300公尺、寬47英吋」之沙發布，應先將寬度（英吋）轉換為公尺，正確算法為 300 × (47 × 0.0254) ≒ 358平方公尺。 關務署籲請業者應正確申報統計用數量，以提升我國貿易統計資料之正確性，該署亦彙整申報統計用數量單位應注意事項及常見錯誤案例，置於海關進出口統計查詢網＞貿易統計＞其他參考資訊＞統計宣導事項（https://portal.sw.nat.gov.tw/APGA/GA17_DEC）＞ 4.統計用數量單位，歡迎民眾及業者多加利用。 新聞稿聯絡人：劉科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2806

trade.title: 第28屆臺史經技合作會議聚焦多元合作，深化經貿夥伴關係
trade.source_name: 經濟部國際貿易署 新聞

trade.raw_summary: 經濟部龔明鑫部長與史瓦帝尼經濟企畫暨發展部吉納部長(Thambo Gina)於今(28)日共同主持第28屆臺史經技合作會議，雙方就協助史商拓銷及採購、婦女創業、建立全民健保制度，以及增進雙方在觀光、資安等領域之合作進行交流。 經濟部龔部長表示，史瓦帝尼是我國在非洲最重要的友邦，雙邊經貿關係平穩，本(2026)年1月至9月我自史國進口金額較2025年同期顯著成長逾210.74%，顯見臺史貿易往來日益密切，經貿關係穩定發展。隨著雙邊經貿持續成長，臺灣已成為史國在亞洲重要貿易夥伴，如經濟部近年持續協助史瓦帝尼業者來臺參加國際展會，增加該國產品國際曝光度及市場商機，另協助史國建置Buy Eswatini手機購物APP，拓展當地業者數位行銷通路，提升產品銷售機會。本年6月台北國際食品展，經濟部特為史國舉辦調酒秀，將該國蘭姆酒搭配我國檸檬，結合兩國特色產品，深化彼此情誼，共同拓展潛在商機。 史方吉納部長則表示，在面臨地緣政治緊張之際，經濟韌性日益重要，史方感謝我政府長期的支持與協助，與史國共同推動各項合作計畫，臺史經技合作會議對強化雙方經貿夥伴關係扮演重要角色，很高興藉此會議平臺拉近彼此的距離，盼雙方擴大目前合作範疇，持續深化交流，以利提升人民生活福祉並續創合作契機。 經濟部指出，臺灣與史瓦帝尼的夥伴關係不僅在貿易連結，更在其他領域富有合作潛力，如我方近年成功促成觀光團赴史旅遊，未來將持續推動臺史觀光合作，並邀請史方率團來臺參與台北國際旅展，吸引更多國人赴史觀光；另外，我方與史國分享推動全民健保相關經驗，樂願協助史國逐步打造人民可平等就醫之環境，未來亦有助我醫療產品拓展非洲市場，顯示雙方正逐漸邁向更全面多元的夥伴關係。 臺史經貿關係穩定發展，自雙方於2018年簽署經濟合作協定(ECA)以來，雙邊貿易持續成長。2025年臺灣為史國第10大進口國，2026年1月至9月我自史國進口金額較2025年同期顯著成長逾210%，展現雙邊經貿合作的豐碩成果。我政府將賡續推動各項經貿交流與合作，史國亦持續在相關國際場域為我發聲，雙方攜手深化夥伴關係，共創互利雙贏局面。 貿易署發言人：胡副署長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7109、02-2397-7178、0966-525-106 業務聯絡人：雙邊貿易二組謝組長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7401

world.title: 避免外交摩擦 日本安保戰略擬不將中國列為威脅
world.raw_summary: （中央社記者戴雅真東京31日專電）日本政府計劃在今年內修訂安全保障3文書，其中「國家安全保障戰略」對中國的定位，傾向維持現行「最大戰略性挑戰」的表述，不升高為「威脅」。分析認為，在日中關係持續降溫、美國尋求與中國建立穩定關係之際，日本政府有意避免因強化措辭引發外交摩擦。
